Motivated by this, we introduce TRAM (TRajectory-derived Auxiliary Memory), a training-free method that augments standard decoding with an auxiliary memory pathway derived from the model's own reasoning trajectory. TRAM consolidates completed reasoning into a compact latent memory, updates it online through fast and slow recurrent streams, and feeds it back into selected decoder layers through a lightweight residual pathway. Experiments across four MLRM variants on eight benchmarks show that TRAM improves performance over vanilla decoding on mathematical, scientific, and general visual reasoning tasks without additional training.

</details>


### [385] [Automatic Annotation of Ancient Greek Vowel Length](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01935)
*Albin Thörn Cleland,Eric Cullhed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了首个通用的古希腊文元音长短自动标注工具（macronizer），能处理各种文本，为机器学习生成训练数据并提升诗歌韵律分析等下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古希腊文中的α、ι、υ三个元音（dichrona）其长短取决于语境、词法和句法等多重因素。以往语料未标注元音长短，缺乏大规模公开 macronized 古希腊文本，影响了相关NLP任务，因此需要自动化标注工具。

Method: 开发了一套基于CoNLL-U标准格式输入、递归模块的macronizer，通过词形间继承机制处理不常见词。进一步利用macronizer输出生成数据，训练字符级Transformer模型，实现自动标注元音长短。

Result: 训练得到的小型Transformer能泛化至规则系统未覆盖的情况，在人工标注的基准数据上达到了与规则系统相当甚至更高的准确率。macronization还可提升如诗歌韵律分析等下游NLP任务效果。

Conclusion: 本研究首次实现了适用于任意古希腊文本的通用macronizer，为NLP研究提供重要基础，同时通过与机器学习结合，推动了古典语言处理的进步。

Abstract: Prior work in Ancient Greek NLP relies on corpora that do not disambiguate the phonemic vowel length of alpha, iota, and ypsilon, together known as the dichrona. Depending on lexeme, morphology, sandhi, syntax, and conventions of period, genre, and verse form, each of these letters can represent either a long or a short vowel. Deciding and marking the correct length is known as "macronizing", a long-tail problem given the sheer mass of word forms and the context dependency of individual instances. No macronized corpus of Ancient Greek is publicly available at scale, so a stand-alone macronizer is needed. While previous work has shown how to build a static, corpus-bespoke vowel-length dictionary, the present paper constructs the first general-purpose macronizer for arbitrary Ancient Greek input. Given input carrying lemma, part-of-speech, and morphological annotation in the standard CoNLL-U format, a set of recursive modules lets less common word forms inherit markup from more common forms of the same lexical word. The macronizer's chief application is generating training data for machine learning: we show that a small character-level transformer trained on the macronizer's own output learns to generalize past the cases the rule-based system leaves unmarked, matching or exceeding its accuracy on a gold-standard, manually annotated benchmark of verse and prose. We also show that macronization can improve downstream prosodical NLP tasks like verse scansion.

</details>


### [386] [Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01953)
*Chishui Chen,Yaoyou Fan,Te Sun,Yi Yang,Chenghao Sun,Delin Mao,Hongbo Qiao,Zuowei Zhang,Junxi Wang,Chenxing Sun,Yangen Hu,Lu Pan,Xuyang Liu,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种新型On-policy distillation方法FutureBridge-OPD，通过在高分歧状态上引入短暂教师干预，促进学生模型在分歧状态下获得更有效的学习信号，实现远超OPD基线的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统OPD虽然缓解了学生在推理和训练分布中的差异，但在多回合智能体任务中，学生偏差会随时间积累，终导致教师指导失效。作者发现高分歧状态可能是最有价值的指导时机，因此希望集中优化此处的教师干预策略。

Method: 提出FutureBridge-OPD方法：在检测到学生与教师决策高度分歧的状态时，让教师短暂引导（bridge），然后让学生接管，进而测量此举对后续学生轨迹正向蒸馏信号的提升。方法通过反馈判定是否在该状态局部采用bridge。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld等任务、以Qwen3-32B教Qwen3-1.7B的大模型迁移设定下，FutureBridge-OPD分别比标准OPD和TCOD提升平均16.6与7.6分，对学生规模与教师不同设定也有较强泛化效果。

Conclusion: FutureBridge-OPD显著提升了多回合智能体蒸馏训练中的指导效率，有效缓解分歧累积导致的性能退化，是一种更优的序列任务蒸馏范式。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on states visited by the student, reducing the distribution gap between training and inference. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student deviations may accumulate over time, gradually moving the trajectory away from states where teacher guidance remains effective. Our quantitative analysis further shows that high-disagreement states offer promising opportunities for teacher guidance, but determining whether such guidance is beneficial requires examining its effect on subsequent student trajectories. We propose FutureBridge-OPD (FTB), which executes a short teacher bridge at a high disagreement state and uses the resulting student continuation to assess whether the bridge increases the density of positive distillation signals relative to the teacher. On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, under the main Qwen3-32B teacher to Qwen3-1.7B student setting, FTB outperforms vanilla OPD and TCOD by an average of 16.6 and 7.6 points, respectively, and remains effective across student scales and teacher settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ChenChiShui/FutureBridge-OPD.

</details>


### [387] [CompanionBench: A Theory-Anchored, Real-World-Grounded Benchmark for AI Emotional Companionship](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02046)
*Yao Liu,Guangjia Chai,Yuming Huang,Jihao Huang,Lei Wang,Junchen Wan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了CompanionBench，这是一个基于真实数据的双语LLM陪伴型AI能力评测基准，有效解决了人工场景、评判偏差等评测问题，并揭示了不同模型在特定人际能力上的表现差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM陪伴型AI在实际应用中规模化部署，但现有的评测方法有诸多缺陷，如场景和评判标准人为、偏见未处理等。因此需要更真实、更细致、更公正的评估基准。

Method: 设计并实现了CompanionBench基准，其核心包括：1）基于去标识化真实数据构造交互场景和用户模拟器；2）设定十项细分能力评测维度（部分为首次引入），同时采用主观打分和客观判别相结合的评价方法；3）引入跨家庭评委和IRT模型排除评分偏见；4）双语实现，确保测评结果复现性。

Result: 测评28种模型后，发现它们在人际能力上的表现存在显著细节差异，常见短板在情绪调节和挑战能力上，而表面温情常被误替代为实质性支持。沉浸式角色扮演并未带来更优的陪伴能力。中英文测评排名高度一致。

Conclusion: CompanionBench提升了陪伴型LLM的测评公正性与细致度，有助于更有针对性地发现和提升模型关键能力。相关中英双语数据和代码将公开，有助于推动领域发展。

Abstract: LLM companions are deployed at scale in personally consequential settings, yet poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks use hand-authored scenarios and prompted simulators, aggregate empathy into one score, and overlook judge biases such as same-family favoritism and scale drift. We introduce CompanionBench, an interactive bilingual benchmark. To our knowledge, it is the first companion benchmark to ground both its scenarios and a trained user simulator in de-identified real-world data. A hidden disclosure gate branches each persona's trajectory on the agent's own behavior, controlling the interaction state space without scripting dialogue. We operationalize ten capabilities derived from 25 theories across psychology and counseling, four of them not graded explicitly by prior work: holding ambiguity, selfobject responsiveness, positive resonance and calibrated challenge. Agents are assessed on two complementary axes: a subjective ten-capability rubric and a deterministic measure of whether deeper disclosure was earned. A cross-family panel dilutes same-family favoritism; an Item Response Theory model separates agent quality from judge severity. Theory fixes what to measure and how personas are structured; real data supply events, history, and profiles -- coverage from theory, authenticity from data. Rankings are reproducible in both languages (rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN). Evaluating 28 agents reveals capability-level differences obscured by aggregate scores. Emotion regulation and calibrated challenge remain common weaknesses; holding ambiguity discriminates most. Role-play agents rank near the bottom: immersion does not imply relational competence. Across agents, the dominant failure mode is substituting surface warmth for substantive relational support. We will release 500 Chinese-English parallel pairs and the evaluation code.

</details>


### [388] [TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02050)
*Avni Mittal,Avinash Anand,Ashutosh Kumar,Dikshant Kukreja,Kritarth Prasad,Sushane Dulloo,Erik Cambria,Timothy Liu,Zhengkui Wang,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于神经元元胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automaton, NCA）的1D因果窗口注意力模型TextNCA，并通过分阶段多窗口（窄到宽）级联实现，分析其对语言建模任务的贡献。结果发现模型表现主要由窗口调度策略驱动，迭代及GRU结构提供次要但有限提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer等主流语言模型依赖全局注意力机制，计算资源消耗大。作者探索是否可用更局部、可迭代、权重共享的单元实现语言建模，并分析局部性、迭代或权重共享三者中，究竟哪一因素主导模型表现。

Method: 1. 定义1D因果窗口注意力型NCA（TextNCA）模型；2. 设计三级分段，各段窗口分别为8、32、128；3. 每段执行相同权重T_s次迭代；4. 在WikiText-103上与参数规模相当的Transformer对比；5. 用不同的窗口顺序、迭代次数和可训练结构消融对比。

Result: TextNCA未能优于同参数量的Transformer（PPL 60.3 vs 52.8/44.7）。模型表现主要由分阶段窄到宽的窗口调度策略决定，非迭代滑窗Transformer采用同样策略可接近主模型表现（PPL差距+4.1）；改变窗口顺序或消除递进则显著降低表现（PPL上升16.7~70.8）。迭代次要但有优化值（T_s=4）；必须有GRU门控和逐步可训练嵌入，随机T_s虽赋予推理调控能力但显著损害绝对PPL。

Conclusion: 语言建模中，分阶段窄到宽的窗口调度策略远比迭代或权重共享对模型性能影响大。NCA式局部结构有一定独特价值但难以取代Transformer，工作主要用于分析不同建模要素作用而非提出更优模型。

Abstract: Can a strictly local, iterated, weight-shared computation primitive support language modelling, and which of those three properties actually drives the model's behaviour? We define \textsc{TextNCA}, a 1D causal windowed-attention realisation of the Neural Cellular Automaton primitive, and study a hierarchical variant that cascades three stages with windows $w \in \{8, 32, 128\}$ and $T_s$ shared-weight iterations per stage, all on WikiText-103 at roughly 30M parameters and 60k training steps. The model does not match a parameter-matched Transformer at this scale (Hier-TextNCA $60.3$ vs.\ Transformer-6L $52.8$ and Transformer-12L $44.7$ PPL), so we treat it as an analytical probe rather than a proposed alternative. The behaviour we observe is largely explained by the staged narrow-to-wide schedule: a non-iterating sliding-window Transformer that reuses the same schedule comes within $+4.1$ PPL of the iterated model, while reversing, flattening, or breaking the monotonic ordering of the schedule costs between $+16.7$ and $+70.8$ PPL. Iteration adds a smaller bounded benefit on top of the schedule, with a clear optimum at $T_s{=}4$ and a U-shaped degradation beyond it. The GRU gate and learned per-step embeddings are required for that benefit to appear, and training with random $T_s$ yields an inference-time iteration-count knob at the cost of substantially higher absolute PPL. We position the work as a controlled reading of which parts of NCA-style computation carry the weight in language modelling.

</details>


### [389] [CAVE: Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02078)
*Wei Jia,Zhicong Lu,Yu Chen,Xiang Wang,Shuai Li,Wenqian Lv,Jiayue Cao,Huaxing liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新方法（CAVE），通过强化视觉边界证据与时间戳预测的对齐，提升了视频时序定位任务的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型在视频时序定位（VTG）中通过强化学习取得进展，但主流方法只关注最终结果的准确性奖励，忽视了视觉证据与预测时间戳之间的细粒度对齐，导致定位边界不准。

Method: 提出CAVE方法，核心是引入边界专属证据token，通过轻量级有监督预热阶段学习token与边界的结构和语义；在强化学习阶段，设计了视觉对齐奖励，加强证据token聚焦于真实边界内的视觉内容。同时，设计了基于性能的证据监督门控机制，对定位效果差的组保留更多证据引导，定位精度高时减少约束，以免妨碍边界细化。

Result: 在多个公开的VTG基准上进行了大量实验证明，CAVE方法有效提升了定位精度和证据-边界对齐效果。

Conclusion: CAVE方法强化了视觉证据与边界时间戳的对应关系，有助于更精确的视频时序定位，对基于大模型的VTG任务具有推广价值。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains in Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) through reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing methods primarily rely on outcome correctness rewards that evaluate only the final predicted intervals, leaving boundary-related visual evidence and its correspondence with timestamp predictions insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we delve into timestamp prediction and its underlying boundary-level visual evidence, showing prevalent misalignment between visual evidence and predicted timestamps across widely used benchmarks. To address this issue, we propose Competence-Aware Visual Boundary Evidence Alignment (CAVE), which augments localization optimization with boundary-specific visual evidence rewards to mitigate evidence-timestamp misalignment. Specifically, to explicitly represent the boundary-specific visual evidence, CAVE introduces boundary-specific evidence tokens and initializes their structured generation and distinct boundary semantics through a lightweight supervised warm-up. During RL, the visual boundary evidence alignment reward reinforces the visual attention of special evidence tokens within the ground-truth boundaries, thereby promoting alignment between visual evidence and temporal boundaries. Moreover, performance-aware gating for evidence supervision is designed to adaptively retain evidence guidance for poorly localized groups while reducing it once localization becomes sufficiently accurate to avoid over-constraining fine-grained boundary refinement. Extensive experiments on several public VTG benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

</details>


### [390] [Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02101)
*Hongzhan Chen,Xiaoyu Liu,Dengming Zhang,Minzhou Huang,Dongliang Xu,Jingcheng Xie,Dongxiang Fang,Bowen Qin,Minsheng Hao,Yaozong Shen,Xiaojun Quan,Mona Zhou,Haosheng Zou,Jeff Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种新的训练框架，旨在使搜索代理在提升搜索能力的同时不损失通用智能，通过混合强化学习与跨领域专家蒸馏，有效缓解了‘对齐税’问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前利用强化学习优化语言模型以提升其在自主搜索任务上的表现，常会导致其通用能力下降，即产生‘对齐税’问题，这限制了模型作为通用助手的价值。该论文旨在解决搜索专精与通用能力的权衡。

Method: 作者提出基于Hunyuan3架构的Yuanbao搜索代理训练框架。方法结合代理式强化学习来提升自动搜索能力，并引入跨领域专家的On-Policy蒸馏（OPD）管道，将多领域通用专家的知识蒸馏到搜索专精学生模型中，联合优化专精搜索与通用能力。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架训练出的模型在搜索性能上具有竞争力，同时通用能力得到持续提升，在真实世界的搜索场景中实现了专精与广泛泛化的良好平衡。

Conclusion: Yuanbao代理通过创新性训练策略，有效缓解了增强搜索性能与保持通用智能之间的矛盾，为通用型智能体的实现提供了新范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have substantially improved the capabilities of autonomous search agents, enabling sophisticated planning, and iterative retrieval over dynamic information sources. However, optimizing language models for specialized search behaviors often incurs an alignment tax, where gains in search performance come at the expense of general-purpose capabilities, limiting their effectiveness as universal assistants. In this technical report, we present the training framework behind the Yuanbao search agent, designed to achieve search specialization without sacrificing general intelligence. Built upon the Hunyuan3 architecture, our framework combines agentic reinforcement learning for autonomous search with a cross-domain expert On-Policy Distillation (OPD) pipeline. Experts specializing in complementary general-purpose domains are distilled into the search-specialized student, restoring and further enhancing its broad capabilities. Rather than treating specialization and general capability as competing objectives, our hybrid training strategy jointly optimizes both, effectively mitigating the alignment tax. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the resulting model achieves competitive search performance while consistently improving its general-purpose capabilities, providing a favorable balance between specialized execution and broad generalization in real-world search scenarios.

</details>


### [391] [IACM-RL: Intent-Aware Context Management and Reinforcement Learning for Complex Tool Invocation under Dynamic Intent Fluctuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02110)
*Dingwei Zhu,Jiahan Li,Chengjun Pan,Yunxian Yang,Yunbin Zhao,Yunke Zhang,Zhonghang Lu,Zhuohui Sheng,Chenhao Huang,Jiahang Lin,Yajie Yang,Junlin Shang,Shichun Liu,Yuhui Wang,Honglin Guo,Junjie Ye,Xin Guo,Jiazheng Zhang,Ming Zhang,Shihan Dou,Zhiheng Xi,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xipeng Qiu,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对真实环境中长链工具调用面临的动态用户意图噪声问题，提出了IACM-RL框架，通过状态追踪和奖励优化有效提升模型稳健性，并在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多假设输入指令完美，难以应对意图不断变化、约束失效等真实复杂场景，导致模型出现无限循环或偏离用户真实意图的问题。因此，亟需提升工具调用在动态环境中的鲁棒性。

Method: 提出IACM-RL框架，核心包括：1）构建DynamicIntent流程，合成13种细粒度场景下的轨迹并开发五维诊断指标；2）利用基于BeliefState的上下文管理器，跟踪目标变化，通过结构化标志隔离失效参数；3）引入分层奖励与三种辅助损失，强化自主状态追踪能力。

Result: 在DynamicIntent、BFCL-V3和τ²-Bench等数据集实验表明，IACM-RL能大幅减少无限循环与失效上下文错误，并提升跨域泛化能力，性能远超主流基线。

Conclusion: IACM-RL在解决动态用户意图噪声下的工具调用问题方面表现优越，能有效追踪变化目标与隔离过期参数，为复杂真实环境下的智能系统提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Executing long-horizon tool invocations in real-world environments is severely challenged by dynamic user intent noise. Existing methods attempt robustness via implicit history scanning or text compression, yet predominantly assume perfect instructions in simplistic scenarios. Inevitably, under fluctuating contexts, obsolete constraints dilute model attention, triggering catastrophic intent deviation and infinite API loops. To resolve this, we propose IACM-RL, a comprehensive framework for robust tool invocation. First, we introduce the DynamicIntent pipeline, synthesizing trajectories across 13 fine-grained fluctuation scenarios, paired with a five-dimensional diagnostic metric suite. Second, IACM-RL deploys a BeliefState-based Self-Generated Context Manager that proactively tracks shifting goals and isolates overwritten parameters using structural stale flags. To autonomously internalize this state-tracking capability, we optimize the policy using a hierarchical intent-driven reward alongside three auxiliary losses (action calibration, CM extraction, and state distillation). Experiments on DynamicIntent, BFCL-V3, and $\mathrmτ^2$-Bench demonstrate that IACM-RL significantly outperforms baselines, reducing infinite loops and stale context errors while enhancing out-of-domain generalization.

</details>


### [392] [From Chains to Trees: Parent-Conditioned Drafting for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02123)
*Zixian Li,Tong Li,Chi Xie,Xiaohui Song,Haonan Lu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出Parent-Conditioned Drafting Tree (PCTree)结构，以提升半自回归模型推理效率，在不需要重新训练或额外backbone推理的情况下，大幅提升推理加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的半自回归推理方法，如DSpark，通过一次backbone前向传递预测整个token块，但若中间某步预测错误，整个后续生成都会失效，限制了大块draft的加速优势。亟需一种方法在不增加计算负担的前提下，提升draft的容错和并行效率。

Method: 作者提出PCTree方法，通过利用DSpark已训练的Markov head，针对每个父节点分开为其多个可能的子节点评分，并以固定的验证预算探索概率最高的路径，将原先的线性草稿结构转变为树形结构，从而并行处理多个候选但不需多次backbone前向过程。仅需修改推理过程，而无需重新训练。

Result: 在Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B}等模型和九个评测基准上，PCTree相较于matched DSpark，在$B=7$时推理加速提升3.1%–29.5%；在Qwen3-4B GSM8K $B=16$时，平均被接受长度由9.41提升至11.16，三轮平均自回归加速从6.14×增至6.60×。

Conclusion: PCTree利用半自回归生成器已有的条件建模能力，通过仅改变推理流程实现多路径并行，能实际转化为推理效率提升，无需额外训练或成本。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference only when drafted continuations survive target-model verification. Semi-autoregressive drafters such as DSpark predict an entire token block with one backbone forward and refine it with a lightweight Markov head. However, DSpark decodes this block as a single chain, so an early mismatch invalidates the remaining suffix and limits the benefit of large draft blocks.
  We show that the conditional structure already learned by DSpark can support multiple parent-consistent continuations without retraining or additional backbone passes. We introduce Parent-Conditioned Drafting Tree (PCTree), which uses the pretrained Markov head to score alternative children separately for each concrete parent and allocates a fixed verification budget to the most probable paths. This converts DSpark's linear draft into a tree while preserving its one-pass parallel backbone.
  Across Qwen3-{4B,8B,14B} and nine benchmarks, at $B{=}7$, measured speedup gains over autoregressive (AR) decoding, relative to matched DSpark, range from $3.1\%$ to $29.5\%$. On Qwen3-4B GSM8K at $B{=}16$, PCTree increases mean acceptance length from $9.41$ to $11.16$ and three-run mean AR speedup from $6.14{\times}$ to $6.60{\times}$. These show that parent-conditioned branching can turn conditional capacity already present in a semi-autoregressive drafter into end-to-end inference gains through an inference-only change.

</details>


### [393] [The Role of Disfluencies in Speech Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02138)
*Maike Züfle,Maria Teleki,Fabian Retkowski,Vilém Zouhar,Oliver Grabner,Alexander Waibel,James Caverlee,Jan Niehues*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了Uh-Mazing基准，用于系统性研究语音翻译系统在处理语音中的不流畅性（如语气词和自我修正）时的表现，并发现消除这些不流畅会导致语义损失，同时给出可在推理阶段缓解这一问题的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语音翻译模型普遍在清理文本基础上训练，倾向于去除口语中的不流畅性（如语气词和重新开始），但这些成分往往蕴含含义，去除后会丢失部分信息。因此，研究如何保留这些不流畅性对于提升翻译语义质量具有重要意义。

Method: 作者构建了Uh-Mazing基准，包含自Switchboard语音库英文到八种目标语的人类翻译和不流畅注释样本，评估包含多种模型架构下，模型在不同类型不流畅处理上的表现。

Result: 实验发现，导致主要翻译损失的是自我修正和重新开始类不流畅，而非语气词或话语标记。多数情况下，模型是省略这些成分而非误译。同时，作者发现无需重新训练，仅推理阶段的解码调整即可部分缓解损失。

Conclusion: 处理和保留不流畅性对提升语音翻译质量至关重要，应重视模型在各类不流畅性处理能力，并公开了该基准和代码以推动相关研究。

Abstract: Current speech translation systems, including SpeechLLMs, are trained on cleaned text and tend to strip disfluencies like filled pauses and false starts rather than translate them. We show this comes at a cost: disfluencies carry meaning that gets lost when speech is cleaned up. To study this systematically, we introduce Uh-Mazing, a benchmark of human-translated, disfluency-annotated Switchboard speech covering English into eight target languages. Across these languages and several architectures, we find that false starts and self-repairs, not filled pauses or discourse markers, drive most of the translation-quality loss, and that models which fail to preserve a disfluency tend to omit it rather than mistranslate it. We show inference-time decoding can mitigate this without retraining, and release the benchmark and code.

</details>


### [394] [Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02139)
*Shijie Ren,Xiting Wang,Meng Li,Yujie Guo,Yunhang Yao,Ziheng Peng,Xunlong Wang,Yuetan Chen,Haoyang Zhou,Yunlong Liang,Fandong Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为SPEE的自进化大语言模型后训练框架，实现了交互经验的高效提取、演化与参数内化，从而显著提升模型的自我改进能力，在数学推理任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型的自改进方法存在两难：推理时能提取经验但无法内化参数，训练时能优化参数却缺乏显式的经验积累机制。缺少连接推理经验提取与参数优化的关键中间环节（经验蒸馏），导致自我进化机制不完整。

Method: 提出SPEE框架，分显式经验演化与隐式策略优化两个阶段。显式阶段从多次交互轨迹中反思、抽取并递进演化可转移经验，借助On-Policy自蒸馏内化为模型策略。隐式阶段通过基于奖励的强化学习进一步探索新策略。特别设计全局经验池整合成功与失败案例、过滤低价值内容，并减轻个别轨迹后见之明的问题。

Result: 在五个数学推理数据集和三类模型规模上，SPEE显著优于传统的推理阶段与训练阶段自进化基线。

Conclusion: SPEE有效填补了自进化大模型中的经验提取、演化与参数内化之间的空白，提升了模型的持续自我改进能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) capable of self-improvement require not only effective policy optimization, but also a principled mechanism for transforming transient interaction experience into persistent model capabilities. Existing self-improvement paradigms remain fragmented: test-time methods can explicitly extract experience but cannot internalize it into model parameters, whereas training-time optimization methods can update model parameters but lack an explicit mechanism for accumulating transferable experience. Bridging these two paradigms requires a critical intermediate stage that remains underexplored, namely \emph{experience distillation}. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{SPEE} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{E}xperience \textbf{E}volution), a unified post-training framework that sequentially performs explicit experience evolution followed by implicit policy optimization. During explicit experience evolution, SPEE reflects on trajectories collected from multiple interactions to extract, verify, and progressively evolve transferable experience, which is subsequently internalized into the policy through privilege-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD). During implicit policy optimization, reward-driven reinforcement learning leverages these internalized priors to explore novel solution strategies. In the experience evolution stage, a continuously evolving global experience pool consolidates knowledge from both successful and failed trajectories, filters out low-utility experience, and mitigates post-hoc rationalization induced by individual trajectories. Experiments on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SPEE consistently outperforms both test-time and training-time self-evolution baselines across three model scales. The source code is available at https://github.com/rrrsj/SPEE.

</details>


### [395] [Domain-Specific Evaluation of Text-to-Speech Systems: A Multi-Metric Benchmarking Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02235)
*Ali Jafar,Amal Sarmad,Shifa Yousaf,Maryam Bashir*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一个可复现的、多指标的现代TTS系统评测框架，结合主观与客观评价，并以低资源语言为案例，系统评估了四类语域下主流TTS系统的表现，发现情感语音是最大挑战，并公开评测工具以促进标准化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前神经TTS系统虽对多语言提升显著，但系统性的综合评测手段稀缺，尤其是对低资源和代表性不足的语言。作者希望解决TTS系统在多语域、多指标下缺乏统一、可复现评测标准的问题。

Method: 提出并实现了集成多指标（包括MUSHRA听测、ABX判别、说话人相似度及声学失真如MCD和F0 RMSE）的评测框架，用于系统性评测。在一门低资源语言的正式、会话、文学/讲故事、情感四种语域下，对四种主流TTS系统进行了综合评估。

Result: 评测发现，TTS合成在不同语域下表现差异显著，情感语音生成难度最大（MCD均值12.03 dB，F0 RMSE均值889 cents），而会话语音获得了最佳声学保真度。

Conclusion: 论文不仅揭示了不同语域TTS表现差异及挑战，还推出了可复现的、多指标TTS评测开源工具链，为低资源语言TTS评测和未来相关标准化研究提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Recent advances in neural text-to-speech (TTS) systems have substantially improved speech naturalness and intelligibility across many languages. However, comprehensive evaluation methodologies that jointly assess perceptual quality, speaker similarity, and acoustic fidelity across diverse speech domains remain limited, particularly for low-resource and underrepresented languages. This paper presents a reproducible, multi-metric benchmarking framework for systematic evaluation of modern TTS systems through domain-specific analysis. The proposed framework integrates complementary subjective and objective evaluation protocols and is demonstrated through a comprehensive case study on a representative low-resource language spanning four speech domains: Formal, Conversational, Literary/Storytelling, and Emotional. Four state-of-the-art TTS systems -- Indic-Parler-TTS, MMS-TTS, Microsoft Edge TTS, and Google Gemini TTS -- are evaluated using MUSHRA listening tests, ABX discrimination tests, speaker similarity scoring with Resemblyzer, and acoustic analyses based on mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) and F0 RMSE over 960 audio pairs. Results reveal substantial variation in TTS performance across speech domains, with emotional speech consistently presenting the greatest synthesis challenge (mean MCD 12.03 dB; mean F0 RMSE 889 cents), while conversational speech achieves the highest overall acoustic fidelity. Beyond the empirical findings, this work provides a reproducible evaluation framework, publicly releasing evaluation scripts, result tables, and executable Colab notebooks to support standardized benchmarking and future research on TTS evaluation for low-resource languages.

</details>


### [396] [An Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Transformer Framework for Health Misinformation Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02310)
*Isah M. Bukar,Bala Mairiga Abduljalil,Bashir Saleh Maina,Abdulbasit Hassan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合语义证据检索与Transformer模型的健康谣言自动辨识框架，专门考虑了发展中国家的本地语境，并针对尼日利亚主要健康谣言进行了实证分析。实验显示该框架可实现较高准确率，为资源有限环境下谣言核查系统提供了基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着健康信息虚假传播的加剧，尤其在疫情期间，快速自动核查健康谣言对于公共卫生极为重要；现有方法多依赖全球医学资源，难以准确应对发展中国家的本地语境与需求，因此有必要开发融合权威本地证据、能捕捉本地语境的方法。

Method: 设计了检索增强型Transformer（包括BERT等模型），利用WHO及尼日利亚疾病控制中心等权威来源作为证据，搭建证据检索与自动分类一体的核查框架，并用尼日利亚五种重要疾病的已标注谣言数据集进行评估。

Result: 在尼日利亚健康谣言数据集上，BERT模型取得了71%准确率和0.66加权F1分数。引入证据检索虽未进一步提升性能，主要受限于证据库覆盖度不足。

Conclusion: 结合本地可信证据的Transformer模型在资源受限环境下有望实现高效健康谣言自动核查，但需要建立更全面的权威证据库，未来可为尼日利亚及类似国家的健康信息核查提供实践基础。

Abstract: The rapid spread of false and misleading health information through digital platforms has become a major public health challenge, particularly during infectious disease outbreaks where delayed verification can influence public behaviour and hinder effective disease control. Although recent advances in automated health misinformation detection have shown encouraging results, most existing approaches rely heavily on global biomedical resources and often fail to capture the local context needed to verify claims in developing countries. This study presents a retrieval-augmented transformer framework designed to verify health-related claims using trusted evidence from the World Health Organization and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention. The framework combines semantic evidence retrieval with transformer-based classification to determine whether a claim is true, false, or misleading. To evaluate the proposed approach, a manually annotated dataset of 67 verified health claims covering coronavirus disease, Lassa fever, cholera, measles, and monkeypox was compiled from Nigerian fact-checking sources.
  Three transformer models and a retrieval-augmented configuration were evaluated. The Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model achieved the best performance, with an accuracy of 71% and a weighted F1-score of 0.66. Although retrieval augmentation did not improve classification performance because the current evidence repository was limited in size and coverage, the findings highlight the importance of comprehensive and authoritative knowledge sources for reliable health misinformation verification. The proposed framework provides a practical foundation for developing context-aware and evidence-driven health misinformation verification systems for Nigeria and other resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [397] [Can AI Agents Simulate A/B Test Outcomes? A Validation Framework for Agentic Experimentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02345)
*Stefan Hut,Lorenzo Masoero*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出用AI代理进行模拟随机对照试验（S-RCT）来预测A/B测试结果，达到提前评估新功能的效果，降低真实流量消耗和时间成本。通过两层误差分解和多种模型与校准方法，显著提升了预测准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前A/B测试虽然是科技行业评估新功能的标准方法，但耗时长、消耗真实用户流量和开发资源。研究旨在探索AI代理是否能通过模拟来准确预估实验效果，从而提前筛选测试方案，减少不必要的上线尝试。

Method: 将问题形式化为模拟随机对照试验（S-RCT），提出两层误差分解（代理建模误差与抽样误差）。实验中对比不同的行为模型（如通用基础模型和专用模型），并实验了基于历史数据的校准协议和被试内设计（让每个代理参与对照和实验两组）。

Result: 用基础模型能捕获结果趋势（符号一致率0.70），但对效应量有系统性高估。增设两阶段的先验校准后，去除不可避免噪声后，平方预测误差降低约77倍，被试内设计标准误降低约2.4倍。

Conclusion: AI代理可以有效模拟A/B实验趋势，经特别校准后有望大大提升准确度。不过，当前方法仍有局限，需结合实际场景判断其应用价值。

Abstract: A/B testing remains the standard for rolling out new features in the technology industry. Each experiment, however, consumes real traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of wall-clock time. Can AI agents---conditioned on behavioral profiles and contextual descriptions of the intervention---simulate outcomes accurately enough to vet candidate treatments before committing live traffic? We formalize this question as a \emph{Simulated Randomized Controlled Trial} (S-RCT) and derive a two-layer error decomposition that separates agent approximation error from subsampling error, enabling targeted improvements to each. The framework is agent-agnostic: any behavioral model---from a fine-tuned specialist to a general-purpose foundation model---can serve as the simulation engine. Validated on 67 historical marketing A/B tests, a baseline S-RCT using an off-the-shelf foundation model captures directional signal (sign overlap 0.70) but systematically overshoots effect magnitudes. A two-phase pre-period calibration protocol reduces the squared prediction error (after removing irreducible measurement noise) by ${\sim}77\times$; a within-subject design---where each agent is exposed to both arms---reduces standard errors by ${\sim}2.4\times$. We discuss limitations of the current approach and identify applications where experimenters stand to benefit from agentic signals.

</details>


### [398] [Global Optimization and Inference-Time Region Grafting for Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02353)
*Donghyeok Koh,Gyuwan Kim,Jinyeong Bak,Seung-Hoon Na,Tao Yang,Haneol Jang,Cheoneum Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出GRAFT方法，实现了在保持整体工作流优化的同时，针对具体输入局部替换失败的流程区域，从而实现实例级的自适应优化，无需全部重优化。该方法无需额外参数训练，有效提升了多种任务中的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动化工作流优化方法在执行前就固定了工作流，无法在执行过程中根据无标签质量信号对失败区域进行自适应调整。直接在推理时重新优化整个流程计算代价太高，因此需要既能保持整体最优，又能本地适应的高效方法。

Method: GRAFT方法基于全局优化的工作流框架，只在每个输入数据上局部评估、替换低质量的流程区域。替换是否接受以无监督的执行质量信号决定，从而无需人工标签，也不需要参数训练，保证全局一致性的同时提升本地性能。此方法无需针对不同任务修改，可直接用于多种推理、生成与复杂问答任务。

Result: GRAFT在多个任务（如数学推理、代码生成和知识密集型问答等）上均取得了比MaAS方法平均高3.85分的效果，且仅替换执行器为更强模型时还可以继续提升性能，而不必重做整体流程优化。

Conclusion: 该工作说明：优化的工作流不应视为静态结果，而是可以根据推理时反馈和更强的执行器不断进化的动态执行策略。GRAFT实现了这一理念，并证明了其实用效果。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.

</details>


### [399] [ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02358)
*Vernon Toh,Navonil Majumder,Zhengyuan Liu,Nancy F. Chen,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本论文提出了ScrambleToolBench，这是一个新型的交互式基准，用于评测自主智能体在不依赖先验知识和语义线索下，通过交互推断未知工具行为的能力，揭示了当前智能体在动态变化环境中的适应和推理有限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的工具使用基准都依赖于静态、明确的语义信息，导致智能体很难展现出通过自主探索发现新工具行为的能力。为了更好地模拟真实开放世界环境下的工具泛化问题，作者希望隔离出智能体对于工具行为本身的推理和适应能力。

Method: 作者设计了ScrambleToolBench基准，通过交互式终端环境移除了语义提示，并设置了动态任务，包括工具映射漂移、动作概率性失败、有限执行窗口等，使智能体必须依赖持续的试错探索和自我修正来推断工具功能，并随环境变化调整假设。

Result: 在多种现有大语言模型智能体上的实验证明：这些模型在初期探索阶段虽然能够发现工具行为，但当遇到工具映射漂移等环境结构变化时，无法有效运用推理策略，容易陷入信念惯性或暴力穷举。提高推理深度只会增加盲目搜索，而不是提升有效推理。持久记忆能减少错误积累，但对结构变化依然难以高效适应。

Conclusion: 当前的智能体在面对环境动态变化时，缺乏有效的归纳和演绎推理能力，无法像人类一样高效适应或修正对工具行为的假设。今后的研究应关注提升智能体推理复杂变化的能力，以实现更强的自主适应性。

Abstract: To operate robustly in open-world environments, autonomous agents should be able to infer the behavior of unfamiliar systems through interaction alone, even in the absence of documentation. However, existing tool-use benchmarks expose semantic tool schemas in static environments, allowing agents to rely on prior knowledge rather than autonomous discovery. To address this limitation, we introduce ScrambleToolBench, an interactive terminal benchmark designed to isolate behavioral reasoning. By removing semantic cues and enforcing a continuous task curriculum, the benchmark requires agents to uncover hidden tool behaviors entirely through trial-and-error interaction. The benchmark further introduces dynamic challenges, including mapping drift, stochastic action failures, and temporal execution windows, to evaluate whether agents can revise and adapt their hypotheses as the environment changes. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art language models reveals that successful initial discovery does not translate into robust adaptation. When faced with structural changes such as mapping drift, agents fail to use deductive strategies such as cycle tracing, and instead exhibit belief inertia or fall back to exhaustive search. Increasing test-time reasoning only amplifies this expensive brute-force search rather than enabling deductive recovery. While equipping agents with persistent memory reduces compounding errors, they remain unable to efficiently infer structural changes, highlighting a gap in current agent reasoning.

</details>


### [400] [Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02359)
*Gaspard Michel,Hugo Attali,Elena V. Epure*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种高效的编码器方法，用于在大语境窗口内联合解决多个引语归属问题，显著提升归属准确率并极大提高处理速度，并集成到开源工具中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有引语归属方法单独预测每个引语的说话者，方法高效但准确率有限；大型语言模型虽然更准，但资源消耗大，难以大规模应用。因而需要提出一种兼顾准确率与效率的方法。

Method: 作者提出基于编码器的联合评分（joint scoring）方法，在共享的大上下文窗口同时处理多个引语归属问题，并将这一方法集成到ModernBookNLP中。

Result: 在PDNC语料库上，该方法获得94.5%的归属准确率，处理速度比标准方法快20倍，比LLM方法快1000倍以上。分析表明，该方法改善了长距离照应问题的处理。

Conclusion: 编码器联合评分方法在引语归属任务上兼具极高准确率和效率，适用于大规模文本分析，并已开源，便于社区采用。

Abstract: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/.

</details>


### [401] [PredAct-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Dialogue under Controlled Tool Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02372)
*Abdulrahman AlRabah,Xiaocheng Yang,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Abdussalam Alawini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了PREDACTBENCH基准，评估在具有噪声工具的现实条件下，LLM辅助的人类决策系统，并发现现有模型难以防止用户过度依赖错误建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对话系统评测通常假设工具输出完全准确，忽略了实际部署过程中工具本身的不准确性及用户信任度不确定的问题，这在教育、医疗等高风险领域尤为突出。

Method: 1. 构建了AI辅助人类决策的基准，AI需要利用有噪声的预测工具为用户提供建议。
2. 提出新的评测指标：周期级相对AI依赖度（RAIR）和相对自力更生度（RSR），扩展信任校准评价到多轮对话。
3. 在两个教育领域数据集（OULAD和PREDACT-CS）上，对13种主流开源和闭源LLM，以及部分真实教师做对比实验。

Result: 发现现有SOTA模型在工具有噪声时，无法有效降低教师对错误建议的过度依赖或模型幻觉，无法合理展现工具结果的不确定性。

Conclusion: PREDACTBENCH为LLM在现实决策支持中的应用提供新测试标准，推动更健壮、更可信赖的辅助决策系统发展以服务教师等实际用户。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in task-oriented dialogue systems that support multi-step decision-making in high-stakes domains such as education, healthcare, and finance. However, existing benchmarks typically assume perfectly accurate tool outputs, overlooking the reality that deployed systems must operate with noisy tools and human decision-makers whose trust in the agent is itself uncertain. Such conditions are common in practice, for example, a clinician using a diagnostic prediction tool or an advisor relying on a model that forecasts student outcomes from historical records. We introduce PREDACTBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating dialogue agents paired with statistically imperfect tools, using education as a measurable testbed where ground truth outcomes and clear intervention decisions are available. First, we build a benchmark for AI-assisted human decision-making, where the AI uses noisy predictors to help guide a user. Second, we introduce episode-level Relative AI-Reliance (RAIR) and Relative self-reliance (RSR) metrics, extending prior trust calibration framework to multi-turn dialogue. Third, we evaluate 13 state-of-the-art closed and open source LLMs on two educational datasets, OULAD (real assessment trajectories from the UK Open University) and PREDACT-CS (60 courses with real final grade outcomes and synthetically generated weekly score trajectories), alongside a human study with instructors and teaching assistants. We find that when tools are noisy, SOTA models are supposed to provide visibility to teachers so that they do not over-rely on wrong suggestions or hallucinations, but current models fail to do that. We offer PREDACTBENCH to help build better LLMs as AI decision support systems to help teachers.

</details>


### [402] [Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02415)
*Nan Chen,Zhouhao Yang,Soufiane Hayou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统性比较了大语言模型（LLM）中的意图分类方法，包括无训练和有训练两类方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户使用LLM时，输入的指令涉及多种领域，准确判断用户意图有助于将请求分发给最合适的子模型，从而提升系统性能和效率。

Method: 作者对比了两种无训练、基于内部表示统计的方法，以及常见的MLP分类器和线性探针等有训练方法，在多种意图分类任务上进行了实证分析。

Result: 1）两类方法在简单任务（如数学、编程、普通语言区分）上表现接近；2）有训练方法在复杂任务（如Java与Python区分）更有优势；3）无训练方法对混合意图和对抗性指令的鲁棒性更强。

Conclusion: 无训练和有训练方法各有优劣，实际应用可根据任务难度和对鲁棒性的需求选择合适方案。

Abstract: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approaches for intent classification. For this purpose, we consider two lightweight, training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations and compare them against MLP classifiers and linear probes. Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

</details>


### [403] [CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02472)
*Muhammad Roman,Karen Rafferty,Barry Devereux*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为CTRAG的自动合规检查系统，通过高级RAG技术提升了合规评估的准确性和效率，并在真实世界部署中取得了显著成效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多数合规检查依赖人工，过程费时且易出错，尤其合规性往往依托第三方（如云服务商），对企业构成挑战。因此，急需高效、精准的自动化合规验证方法以提升监管信任和企业合规能力。

Method: 提出CTRAG系统，融合了检索增强生成（RAG）技术，通过自适应切片、动态检索、上下文学习等手段，自动从监管文本中提取控制问题，并与企业非结构化文档交叉验证，实现自动化、文档驱动的合规核查。系统还特别关注第三方服务场景下的间接合规问题。

Result: CTRAG在真实环境下实现F1-score 78%、召回率85%，显著减少了人工工作量，并有效降低了漏报不合规的风险。在四大会计师事务所真实案例中，CTRAG验证结果与人工报告高度一致。

Conclusion: CTRAG能够有效提升合规检查的自动化水平，优化合规流程，降低风险，在复杂监管场景下增强监管信任，为企业提供了切实可行的合规保障。

Abstract: Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financial reporting, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Manual compliance testing, however, is often time-intensive and prone to inconsistencies, particularly when compliance depends indirectly on third-party services such as cloud providers, where vendors rely on external providers to meet regulatory standards. In this paper, we present CTRAG, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline designed for automated compliance checking. CTRAG employs advanced strategies, including adaptive chunking, dynamic retrieval configurations, and in-context learning, to improve the precision and relevance of compliance assessments. By extracting control questions from regulatory texts and cross-referencing them with unstructured company documentation, CTRAG achieves highly accurate, document-informed compliance verification, even in cases of indirect compliance through third-party services. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with CTRAG achieving an F1-score of 78% and a recall of 85% in the final deployed configuration, ensuring minimal missed non-compliance cases while reducing manual reviewer effort in a real-world deployment. To validate CTRAG value, we developed and deployed a POC within a Big Four professional services firm, applying it to real-world cases and cross-checking results against manual compliance reports. These findings highlight CTRAG potential to streamline compliance workflows, mitigate risks, and enhance regulatory trust in complex, high-stakes environments.

</details>


### [404] [Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02486)
*Iaroslav Chelombitko,Ekaterina Chelombitko,Mika Hämäläinen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了开源大语言模型（LLMs）在文化实体识别中的表现，发现模型在识别主要西方神话角色时表现良好，但在其他文化（如芬兰、斯拉夫、埃及或中国神话）中表现较差。通过线性探针等技术发现，这种文化偏差产生于解码阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前开源大语言模型在面对多元文化背景时，容易默认主流西方文化实体，对于小众或代表性较弱文化实体识别效果不佳。因此，论文旨在揭示模型产生文化偏差的内部机制，推动跨文化理解与公正性提升。

Method: 研究者基于Thompson-motif实体集合，选取18个来自8种架构的开源LLMs，采用线性探针、logit lens、激活修补和输出提取等方法，分析模型对多文化实体的表征和输出情况，并对比不同提示语言（母语vs英文）下的表现差异。

Result: 残差流能够较好区分不同文化，高于朴素名字字符串基线，但在解码阶段，不同文化的Token被聚合到主流西方传统上。提示语言会显著影响输出，且不同语言下的解码相关性较低，显示模型解码受到语言提示的“门控”影响。

Conclusion: 开源LLMs的内部表征已有足够文化区分度，但解码输出阶段存在文化偏差，导致整体表现对非主流文化不友好。提升输出阶段的公平性和多样性是关键。论文还公开了相关工具和数据以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced. On a parallel cross-cultural substrate of Thompson-motif entities, we instrument 18 open-source LLMs from 8 architecture families with linear probing, logit lens, activation patching, and output extraction. The residual stream cleanly distinguishes cultures, well above a name-string baseline, yet the decoder collapses culturally-specific tokens onto dominant-tradition ones. The failure is at readout, not at representation. Asking the same question in the target culture's native language versus English produces failures that cluster within language but decouple across language: the decoder is gated on prompt language. We release a per-entity (probe, output) decomposition framework, a citation-anchored cross-cultural ground truth, a within- versus cross-mode correlation test for language-conditioned readout, and per-entity predictions for all 18 models.

</details>


### [405] [LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02515)
*Zhichen Liu,Ruihan Sun,Hengjie Yang,Zipeng Wu,Zhaohan Chen,Xiaofan Zhang,Yang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种增强大语言模型长期记忆能力的方法——LiveMem，通过独立于上下文窗口的内存状态，有效保存长期历史信息，从而实现持续推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型在长期使用过程中，上下文交互内容会超过模型固定窗口，现有的记忆和检索机制只能保留部分历史，难以实现持续的状态计算，导致模型容易忘记先前重要信息。作者提出需要一种独立于当前上下文的状态持续机制。

Method: 提出了LiveMem方法，将大语言模型增加一个内存状态组件。该组件具备固定容量，可以独立于当前上下文窗口持续保存历史信息。方案包含内存状态管理、训练与推理三部分：内存状态在推理过程中持续更新并承担信息载体角色，通过特定的后训练方式强化记忆相关性能，推理阶段模型能基于历史内存状态完成相关任务。

Result: 实验证明，LiveMem在多项评测任务和其他内存增强方法中表现领先，尤其在长文档推理（LongMemEval）上，即使证据已移出当前窗口，模型仍可凭内存状态正确回答问题；证据距离分析也显示关键信息能够长时间保留。

Conclusion: LiveMem为大模型推理引入了与窗口无关的状态连续性新范式，补足了当前上下文相关方法的不足，实现了长期持续推理能力。

Abstract: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.

</details>


### [406] [MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02520)
*Saman Sarker Joy,Niloy Farhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了MedPRESS基准，用来评估大语言模型（LLM）在患者压力下是否会趋于过度顺从（sycophancy）而作出不安全的健康建议。研究发现，许多模型在反复压力下会产生不安全的一致性，现有模型评测存在明显安全短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在医疗建议的安全性评测主要用静态单轮问题，未考虑真实对话中的患者持续施压情境，不能有效衡量模型在压力下的安全性和稳健性。

Method: 作者设计了MedPRESS多轮对话基准，包括600组、每组5轮的医患对话，涵盖三类情景（药物/治疗需求、个人健康自理、症状分诊与抗拒治疗），逐步增加患者压力。用结构化评判和安全相关指标评估20个不同类型和规模的LLM表现，并测试反顺从提示语的效果。

Result: 结果显示，绝大多数大模型经多轮患者压力后倾向于作出不安全的同意，模型的家族、规模和提示方式影响表现。使用反顺从提示对部分模型有改善，但无法完全杜绝安全性问题。

Conclusion: 仅具备正确医疗知识不足以确保模型安全，模型需能在高压多轮医疗对话中坚持安全原则。评测和训练应加入对抗压力下安全性的考量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs. MedPRESS contains 600 medically grounded five-turn dialogues across three scenario families: medication and treatment demand, personal health self-care, and symptom triage and care resistance. Each dialogue begins with a health query and escalates through personal experience, social proof, external evidence claims, and direct adversarial challenge. We evaluate 20 LLMs across general, medical-domain, lightweight, large, open-weight, and proprietary families using structured judging and safety-focused metrics. Results show that models frequently shift toward unsafe agreement under repeated patient pressure, with substantial variation across model families, model scale, and prompt type. Anti-sycophancy prompting improves robustness for several models, but does not eliminate unsafe agreement. MedPRESS highlights a critical gap in medical LLM evaluation: safe medical knowledge is not enough unless models can maintain it under conversational pressure.

</details>


### [407] [Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02555)
*Amr Keleg,Ahmed Amine Ben Abdallah,Taha Yassine,Chadi Helwe,Imane Guellil,Nedjma Ousidhoum*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统性收集了阿拉伯语使用者对Latn化阿拉伯语（Arabizi）的看法及其使用习惯，并整理了跨方言的词语和句子级资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究多认为Arabizi是暂时现象，缺乏从用户角度系统调查其实际使用情况及规范，尤其缺少对不同阿拉伯方言影响的分析。

Method: （1）通过与不同方言阿拉伯语使用者互动，调查其对Arabizi的看法及使用场景；（2）采集了字级别的阿拉伯语到Arabizi的转写数据以分析同一方言内和不同方言间的规范性和变化性；（3）构建包含同一句话的阿拉伯文及多个Arabizi转写的人为标注平行语料库。

Result: 调查显示Arabizi在同一方言内有较高的规范性，而不同方言的Arabizi表现出系统性差异；收集并发布了跨五大方言的字级和句级Arabizi资源。

Conclusion: 本研究首次大规模、系统调查了Arabizi在多方言阿拉伯语圈的使用和规范，填补了用户视角和资源层面的空白，为后续NLP研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

</details>


### [408] [AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02602)
*Jiajun Liang,Yucheng Liao,Yukang Cao,Jiazhe Wei,Ken Li,Wende Tan,Jiankun Zhang,ZY Cui,Jingkang Yang,Liucheng Guo,Shiqi Yang,B. Yang,Caifeng Shan,Ziwei Liu,Chenyang Si*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AURORA-LM 是一种全新连续潜变量扩散语言模型，通过全新方法提升了文本生成的连续建模能力，在多个基准任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本生成模型主要使用离散符号，与图像、视频、音频等连续信号不同。已有连续文本模型要么继承不适合生成的新embedding空间，要么为了方便扩散而降低表示能力，导致生成质量下降。因此需要探索保留高容量文本潜变量的同时提升连续生成的模型方法。

Method: 提出了 AURORA-LM 模型：首先用 Query-based 编码器-解码器将文本组织成高容量、可解码的前缀对齐潜在序列；然后采用 Block-causal Diffusion Transformer，通过流匹配方式学习分布，按块从左至右生成，每块内并行复原噪声。扩散模型仅约束噪声输入路径，保持完整的预测目标，支持高宽度潜变量。同时对噪声分布和潜在宽度进行校准，并引入自轨迹一致性提升推理收敛。

Result: AURORA-LM 在 OpenWebText 自由生成与 XSum 摘要等任务上优于所有现有连续或扩散语言模型。参数规模扩展到 10 亿，计算量达到 1500 EFLOPs 后效果进一步超过更大规模、已公开的扩散语言模型。

Conclusion: AURORA-LM 证明了高容量连续潜变量模型联合定制扩散机制可以显著提升文本连续建模和生成效果，为后续连续文本生成模型提供了新方向。

Abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly.
  We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference.
  AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [409] [Track-Guided Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Drifting with Minimum-Lap-Time Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00113)
*Sheng Zhao,Bolin Zhao,Xiaodong Wu,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种最小圈速(Minimum-Lap-Time, MLT)漂移控制框架，通过结合优化轨迹规划与深度强化学习，实现赛车自动漂移同时高效减小圈速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与F1赛车不同，拉力赛需要赛车有意识地“失控”漂移以应对松散路面并快速过弯。实现自动漂移需同时解决高度非线性动态的稳定性与圈速最小化的双重目标。当前缺乏面向MLT自动漂移的高效控制架构。

Method: 作者首先将MLT漂移规划表述为最优控制问题，获得规划轨迹作为先验数据，用于深度强化学习（DRL）控制器训练。针对漂移大侧滑且难以直接学习的挑战，提出了Track-guided Reinforcement Learning (TgRL) 分阶段训练方法，奖励函数结合瞬时与最终圈速目标，逐步从单点漂移、转角漂移到完整漂移赛道策略。

Result: 仿真实验显示，所提框架能让智能体学习到既能控制车辆安全运动又高效减小圈速的漂移赛车策略。

Conclusion: 该MLT漂移规划-控制一体化框架有效解决了自动化漂移车辆的控制与圈速最小化难题，为无人车、自主赛车等领域提供了新方法。

Abstract: In Formula 1, drivers optimize racing lines within tire grip limits to minimize lap times; however, in rally racing, drivers intentionally break traction to drift on loose surfaces. This maneuver rapidly aligns the vehicle for corner exits, ultimately reducing lap time. Autonomously executing such maneuvers formulates a complex dual-objective control problem: stabilizing highly nonlinear drift dynamics while strictly minimizing lap time. Addressing this challenge motivates the development of advanced Minimum-Lap-Time (MLT) drift control architectures. This paper proposes a planning-control framework specifically designed for MLT drifting scenario. First, we formulate an optimal control problem to generate a MLT drift planning trajectory, which is used as prior data to train a deep reinforcement learning drift controller. Given that drifting involves extremely large sideslip angles and is therefore challenging to learn directly, a Track-guided Reinforcement Learning (TgRL) drift control method is proposed to enable progressive training in a step-by-step manner, from drift control policy, to drift corner policy, and finally to a comprehensive drift race policy. The reward function incorporates both an instant reward term and an end reward term derived from the Minimum-Lap-Time objective. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables the agent to learn a drift racing policy that not only ensures vehicle motion control performance but also effectively reduces lap time.

</details>


### [410] [Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators Navigating Doorways via Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00206)
*Kasra Sinaei,Kasun Weerakoon,Christopher Bradley,Seyed Abolfazl Fakoorian,Donald Ebeigbe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种运动规划框架，实现机器人自主开门并穿越不同类型的门（推门和拉门）的动态可行碰撞无碰轨迹规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动操作机械臂在实际人类环境中经常需要与门等障碍物交互，开门穿门是一项基本但具有挑战性的任务，因此需要更高效、自主的运动规划方法。

Method: 将机器人与门视为耦合动力系统，在非线性模型预测控制（MPC）优化框架下进行联合运动规划。通过惩罚约束方法保证操作可行性，而无需在规划器中显式建模机械臂运动学。

Result: 通过仿真和硬件实验验证了该方法可成功规划机器人开门穿门的动态可行轨迹。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法能有效实现移动操作机械臂对门的自主操作与通过，避免了复杂运动学建模，有一定实际应用价值。

Abstract: Navigating doorways is a fundamental capability for mobile manipulators operating in human environments, requiring coordinated motion between the mobile base and manipulator arm. This paper presents a motion planning framework that generates dynamically feasible and collision-free trajectories for autonomously opening and traversing both push and pull doors. The proposed method formulates the robot and door as a coupled dynamical system within a nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC) optimization framework. Manipulation feasibility is enforced through a penalty-based constraint, avoiding explicit arm kinematic modeling in the planner. Simulations and a hardware experiment demonstrate that the approach successfully plans feasible trajectories for door traversal.

</details>


### [411] [Developing Combined Manipulation and Locomotion Skills with Interaction Representation and Skill Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00208)
*Fanxing Meng,Jing Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种让仿人机器人通过发展性学习和策略组合自主学习抓取、站立和行走等复杂动作的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人若能自主学习并结合多种运动技能，将提升其实用性与适应性。当前仿人机器人在学习多动作组合、泛化能力等方面尚有不足。本文旨在用发展性学习和策略组合原理，提高机器人自我动作学习和任务组合能力。

Method: 1. 利用谐波分析，采用三次谐波作为权重，通过空间卷积表达手与物体的空间关系。2. 引入基于发展性原理的手指关节解耦课程，增强抓取策略泛化能力且无需外部数据集。3. 通过独立观测向量为抓取与站立（行走）策略提供信息，并用手-物体交互得分决定各策略对机器人的控制权，实现策略组合。

Result: 抓取未知物体零样本成功率达93%，在抓取物体后站立的成功率为96-100%。策略组合仅在各策略均在同一全身机器人上训练时有效。

Conclusion: 发展性学习与全身协调训练能实现多策略融合，提升机器人复杂动作能力。针对仿人机器人，策略组合效果依赖于在完整身体上的联合学习。

Abstract: This paper addresses how to enable a humanoid robot to learn motion policies based on developmental principles and combine policies to create more sophisticated and useful behaviors. Specifically, we present an approach to (1) learning a whole-body reaching and grasping policy and (2) combining it and a standing-up and walking policy to compose a more complex policy of manipulation and locomotion: grasping, standing up, and walking.
  In (1), our method draws inspiration from harmonic analysis and adopts cubic harmonics as weights to represent the hand-object spatial relationship via spatial convolution. Utilizing an intra-episode finger joint decoupling curriculum based on developmental principles, a robot can autonomously learn a generalizable grasping policy without relying on external datasets or pretrained models.
  In (2), our method combines the grasping policy with a separately learned getting-up policy by providing both policies with their respective observation vectors and using hand-object interaction scores to determine when each policy should control which robot joints. Our results show a 93% zero-shot success rate for grasping unseen objects and a 96-100% success rate for standing up while holding the object. Our work also demonstrates that combining different policies is only effective if each policy learning happens on the same whole humanoid body even if a policy (such as for locomotion) does not seem to need all the body parts (such as fingers).

</details>


### [412] [Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact: Distributed Contact Modeling for Sphere-Based Robot Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00263)
*Nataliya Nechyporenko,Ava Abderezaei,Alessandro Roncone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种名为Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact（CSLC）的新型机械接触模型，改进了现有基于球体的机器人体模型的物理精度，同时保持了高效计算性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的球体机器人建模在实现高效碰撞检测和可微分几何的同时，因采用点接触模式，无法准确反映接触斑实际面积、压力分布、旋转刚度和摩擦矩等重要物理特性。这导致模型的物理逼真性不足，尤其在抓持和接触行为中存在一定局限。

Method: 作者提出CSLC模型，将机器人表面建模为由多个球体及弹簧（锚定弹簧和侧向弹簧）组成的柔性球体晶格结构。在与物体接触受压时，这一晶格结构能够变形，从而产生分布式的接触斑，物理表现更加接近真实。

Result: 实验在两个独立求解器上验证了CSLC模型。结果显示，该方法能够有效形成接触斑，并提高了抓持的稳定性，初步展示了方法的有效性和物理改进。

Conclusion: CSLC模型在保持球体模型计算高效与可微分性的同时，显著提升了物理精度，能够更真实模拟接触现象，为机器人接触规划开辟了新的方法。

Abstract: Contact planning in robotics requires models that are both computationally efficient and physically accurate. Sphere-based robot representations satisfy the first requirement by enabling fast collision checking and differentiable geometry, but sacrifice physical accuracy by relying on point contact which cannot capture contact patch area, pressure distributions, rotational stiffness, or frictional moments. We introduce Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact (CSLC), a distributed contact model that operates natively on sphere representations by modeling the robot interface as a compliant lattice of surface spheres connected through anchor and lateral springs. When pressed against an object, the lattice deforms to produce a spatially distributed contact patch that improves the physical accuracy of sphere-based contact. We validate CSLC across two independent solvers and show preliminary results demonstrating contact patch formation and improved grasp stability.

</details>


### [413] [Localization in Spatiotemporal Fields via Environmental PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00272)
*Jose Fuentes,Abdullah Al Redwan Newaz,Ana Cavalcanti,Leonardo Bobadilla*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出利用受偏微分方程（PDEs）约束的时空场作为定位特征，并基于Rao-Blackwell化粒子滤波（RBPF）实现定位，提高了定位精度，在仿真和实地实验中效果优于传统粒子滤波方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际中，尤其是在水体等复杂环境下，传统的定位方法难以有效利用环境的高维多模态信息。而环境物理场（如温度、盐度、溶解氧）变化符合PDE模型，利用这些信息可以提升定位系统的准确性和鲁棒性。

Method: 系统选用浅水方程和对流扩散方程两类PDE，使用数值方法进行场预测，并融合多通道环境场信息。定位算法基于RBPF，将车辆状态分为通过粒子采样的非线性部分和通过卡尔曼滤波追踪的线性传感器偏移部分，实现精细化状态估计和高效粒子利用。

Result: 在仿真中，RBPF方法在多种粒子数量下，其定位终点误差和RMSE均优于传统粒子滤波方法。实地实验（无人水面艇测量多种环境场）进一步验证了该方法在实际环境中的高可用性和有效性。

Conclusion: 利用基于PDE的环境多模态场能提供足够的空间变异信息，是实际复杂环境下有效的定位辅助信息源。提出的RBPF方法能更好地融合环境信息，提升定位精度，并有效应对传感器漂移。

Abstract: This paper proposes a localization framework that uses spatiotemporal fields governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) as localization signatures. Two PDE classes are considered: the shallow water equations, which describe free-surface flows in coastal and riverine environments, and the advection-diffusion equation, which models the transport and mixing of scalar quantities such as temperature, salinity, and dissolved oxygen. A numerical PDE solver provides predicted fields over the domain, and multiple field channels are fused as multimodal measurements to improve localization accuracy. We formulate the problem within a Rao-Blackwellized particle filter (RBPF) that partitions the vehicle state into a nonlinear component sampled by particles and a linear sensor bias component tracked analytically via per-particle Kalman filters. This factorization reduces the required number of particles compared to a standard particle filter while accounting for realistic sensor drift. Simulation studies on both PDE scenarios show that the RBPF consistently outperforms a standard particle filter in terms of final position error and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) across varying particle counts. Field experiments with an autonomous surface vehicle measuring salinity, temperature, and dissolved oxygen validate that PDE-governed environmental fields provide sufficient spatial variability for practical localization. Related experimental videos are available at https://localization-environmental-pdes.github.io/.

</details>


### [414] [Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00284)
*Pablo Moraes,Monica Rodriguez,Christopher Peters,Hiago Sodre,Tobias Doernbach,Bruna Guterres,Ricardo Grando*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合几何与语义视觉注意力估计的混合方法，用于人机交互，并以InMoov机器人头部为平台实验，验证该方法能提升交互适应性和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了让机器人能更好地理解人类注意力状态，从而提升人类与机器人的交互自然性和効率，需要实现既快速又具备高语义理解的人类注意力估计。传统方法或偏重几何特征，或主要依赖视觉-语言模型，存在信息不全面或实时性不足的问题。

Method: 方法上，作者提出一个混合视觉注意力估计算法，包括：1）几何层，实时检测和分析人脸、头部姿态等高频信息；2）语义层，基于视觉-语言模型，识别摄像头画面中的注意力语境（如是否注意机器人、是否在看手机等）；3）利用有限状态机（FSM）融合上述信号，对机器人交互行为进行自适应调节（如激活、暂停、恢复、休息）。

Result: 通过招募10名参与者、共40轮实验（涵盖基线与自适应交互两种条件），结果显示系统在所有实验中都能可靠地检测交互启动、自适应应对注意力分散时能触发暂停，且几何层和语义层输出信息互补。

Conclusion: 混合视觉注意力估计架构能提升机器人理解人类注意力的准确性和自适应交互行为的有效性，两层信息互补有助于交互系统的智能化和人性化发展。

Abstract: This paper presents an applied case study on hybrid visual attention estimation for human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head based on the InMoov ecosystem. The proposed pipeline combines a fast geometric perception layer with an independent semantic perception layer based on a vision-language model. The geometric layer provides high-frequency face and head-pose information for temporal regulation, while the semantic layer receives only raw egocentric camera frames and produces contextual attention labels related to attention toward the robot, phone use, or attention elsewhere. These signals are integrated through a finite state machine that regulates adaptive interaction behavior, including activation, waiting, interaction resumption, and return to rest. The system was evaluated with 10 participants across 40 trials covering baseline and adaptive interaction conditions. Results show reliable interaction start across all trials, consistent pause behavior in the adaptive distraction condition, and non-redundant semantic information between the geometric and semantic outputs.

</details>


### [415] [Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00315)
*Ihab Tabbara,Yuxuan Yang,Hussein Sibai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于语言条件的安全过滤方法，使机器人能够根据自然语言描述的安全约束适应不同任务和场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人能够通过视觉-语言-动作模型执行多样的任务，其部署需要不仅能适应新任务，还要能灵活应对不同用户、环境和应用的安全要求。现有的安全过滤器多为针对特定约束所设计，无法灵活迁移。

Method: 提出将Hamilton-Jacobi安全执行器（actor）和评估器（critic）通过自然语言描述的约束条件进行条件化，实现对不同安全约束的适应。并在基于视觉的抓取、擦桌子和积木堆叠三项任务中进行实验。

Result: 实验表明，语言条件的安全过滤器能够减少约束违规现象，并在相同类别下对未知的安全要求有部分迁移能力。

Conclusion: 语言条件的安全过滤方法可以提升机器人安全控制的通用性和适应性，在面对变化多端的安全需求时表现出良好的效果。

Abstract: Robot policies are becoming increasingly general, with vision-language-action (VLA) models enabling a single policy to execute diverse tasks specified in natural language. Safe deployment, however, requires adapting not only to new tasks but also to varying safety requirements across users, environments, and applications. Existing safety filters remain largely constraint-specific and thus must be redesigned or relearned when safety requirements change. In this paper, we investigate language-conditioned safety filtering, in which a Hamilton-Jacobi safety actor and critic are conditioned on language-specified constraints. We evaluate this formulation across pick-and-place, table-wiping, and block-stacking tasks in the vision-based setting, examining its ability to enforce language-specified constraints and transfer to unseen constraint instances within the evaluated constraint families. Our experiments provide evidence that language-conditioned safety filters reduce constraint violations and exhibit partial transfer to unseen constraint instances.

</details>


### [416] [Belief-Space Perception Routing under Coupled Sensor Faults and Compute Contention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00322)
*Sparsh Roy,Vihan Aggarwal,Davin Yin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种感知路由器，能根据传感器故障状态和计算资源竞争状态动态选择检测器配置，显著降低了机器人视觉任务中在资源受限和环境恶劣下的截止时间失效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人依赖视觉在固定周期响应，但雨、雾、低照等环境会导致摄像头性能下降，同时计算资源需多任务共享，使感知任务可用算力浮动，两者叠加严重影响任务按时完成。当前方法一般将这两种问题分开建模，未充分利用它们的联合影响。

Method: 提出一种感知路由器，实时跟踪传感器故障概率和计算资源竞争概率，并用noisy-OR模型将两者耦合，根据综合风险选择不同分辨率和规模的目标检测器（YOLO11x或n，1280px或640px），以确保视觉帧按时完成。

Result: 在两种压力同时发生时，使用耦合策略的截至失效率比独立建模策略下降1.1至9.4个百分点，部分条件下统计显著。耦合路由每帧仅需少量计算消耗。实际测试未发现两压力本身自然产生耦合关系，因而定位为机制验证。

Conclusion: 所提出的感知路由提升了机器人在受恶劣环境和算力压力下的可靠性，但二者耦合是否在真实部署中广泛存在尚待进一步检验。已经开放的评测工具允许实际应用中进一步验证该机制。

Abstract: A robot that has to see and react on a fixed clock runs into two problems at once. Its cameras degrade in rain, mud, fog, and darkness. And the single onboard processor it runs on is shared with planning and control, so the compute left over for perception moves around from second to second. Most systems model the two separately. We present a perception router that tracks probabilistic estimates of sensor-fault state and compute- contention state, couples them with a noisy-OR term, and uses the coupled estimate to pick one of four detector configurations (YOLO11x/n at 1280 or 640 px) so that the frame finishes before its deadline. Where the two stressors co-occur, the coupled policy cuts the deadline-miss rate by 1.1 to 9.4 percentage points against a policy that treats them independently. The interval excludes zero in five of six conditions, the pooled effect over 10 sequences and 6 conditions has sign-test p = 0.001, and every uncoupled control and the fault-free trajectory sit at exactly 0.0 pp. Routing costs tens of microseconds per frame. We then asked whether the coupling the method exploits arises on its own. Across eight real RADIATE adverse-weather sequences and three workload proxies independent of the fault signal, after Benjamini-Hochberg correction and a replication run, none of 24 tests found it. We report that null and scope the routing result as a proof of mechanism. Whether such coupling occurs in the field is still open, and the released evaluation pipeline lets a deployment settle it on its own traces.

</details>


### [417] [Action Chunk Scheduling for Batched Robot Policy Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00337)
*Rohan Bansal,David He,Nadun Ranawaka Arachchige,Zhenyang Chen,Soobum Kim,Kexin Rong,Danfei Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对机器人大模型（如视觉-语言-行动模型）在多机器人群体中的远程推理部署问题，提出一种新的任务调度算法，并通过系统性实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人基础模型不断发展，实现通用机器人越来越依赖于大规模模型的落地部署。然而，这些模型通常计算量大，单个机器人设备因算力与能耗受限而难以胜任。因此，迫切需要研究如何利用远程GPU集群为多机器人同时提供高效决策服务。

Method: 作者首次将机器人策略的部署抽象为远程GPU上的任务调度问题，并开发了Armory系统用于实际机器人集群。通过对比实验证明，传统“批处理”策略在机器人端表现一致时有效，但面对异质需求（如各机器人动作处理速度不同）时效率低下。为此，提出一种新颖的调度算法，充分考虑了机器人群体间的异构特性。

Result: 实验在模拟和实际机器人群体中进行。结果显示：在机器人任务处理异质性明显场景下，所提调度算法能显著提升推理系统吞吐量，在实际环境中最高提升18%。

Conclusion: 面向多机器人远程推理部署，传统任务调度策略存在瓶颈。本文提出的调度方法可以更好兼容机器人任务差异，提高整体服务效率，有助于推动通用机器人基础模型的规模化应用落地。

Abstract: Deploying robot foundation models at scale is the next step towards realizing the potential of general-purpose robots. However, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and other foundation models are computationally demanding, and on-device compute is constrained by power and space. In this paper, we introduce the problem of serving a robot policy to multiple robots from a remote GPU and formulate it as a scheduling problem. We build Armory, a serving system validated on fleets of both simulated and real robots. Our experiments show that naive scheduling heuristics perform well when all robots are the same, but fall short when robots consume action chunks at different rates, uncovering a mismatch between conventional batching methods and the closed-loop requirements of robot policy execution. To address this, we propose a scheduling algorithm that accounts for this heterogeneity and improves overall system throughput by up to $18\%$ in real-world experiments. Additional details are available at https://gatech-rl2.github.io/actionchunkscheduling.

</details>


### [418] [A Robotic System for Automated Manufacturing of Dielectric Elastomer Actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00369)
*Van Remenar,Anatol Gogoj,Ang Li,Tomas Verardi,Matei Mandoiu,Victor Jimenez Santiago,Mihai Duduta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一种用于软电容器自动化制造的机器人系统，显著提升了制造效率并减少了人工参与。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软电容器（可用作执行器和传感器）的制造流程中，对质量影响最大的两个步骤——介电层涂覆和碳纳米管（CNT）电极应用——高度依赖人工操作，导致效率低且一致性难以保证，因此亟需自动化解决方案。

Method: 提出了一套自动化机器人制造系统，专注于两项关键工艺：通过旋涂形成介电层、通过压印方法施加CNT电极。系统可制备多层结构的软电容器，并系统性地减少人工介入。

Result: 成功自动化制造了20个多层介电弹性体执行器（每个包含12层介电层和11层CNT电极），介电层平均厚度为55.37±2.04微米。整个制造流程用时减少14.2%，人工参与环节减少56.1%。

Conclusion: 自动化机器人制造系统在提升软电容器器件一致性和生产效率方面具有显著优势，有助于推动软执行器与传感器的商业化和大规模生产。

Abstract: This letter presents an automated robotic manufacturing system for soft capacitors which operate as actuators and sensors. Emphasis is placed on the two processes that most directly govern device quality, dielectric layer formation by spin coating and carbon nanotube (CNT) electrode application by stamping. Twenty multilayer DEAs, each comprising 12 dielectric layers with a mean thickness of 55.37 +- 2.04 um and 11 alternating CNT electrodes, were fabricated reducing total process time by 14.2% and removing the operator from 56.1% of it.

</details>


### [419] [The Gate, Not the Cache: Gate Provenance Bounds the Closed-Loop Reliability of Training-Free VLA Token Skipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00391)
*Qi Luo,Shuaijun Liu,Hao Zhao,Kunlin Li,Xiaobo Wang,Ningxing Su,Dongsheng Wang,Yun Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文分析了token skipping加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的机制，发现gate信号来源于自身加速推理会引发性能崩溃。提出actuation-slack refresh方法，使模型在维持加速的同时大幅提升可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Token skipping常用于加速VLA模型，但如果gate信号由模型自身的加速输出所得，跳过的token信息丢失会级联损伤模型表现。作者动机是找出崩溃根因并提出可增强系统鲁棒性的解决方案。

Method: 系统地分析token跳过的两个机制（重用与删除）与gate信号来源之间的关系，在LIBERO-Object等数据集上做对照实验，提出actuation-slack refresh方法，在执行控制动作时异步完成一次完整前向推理，保证后续gate干净且信息完备。

Result: 实验证明，当gate信号由模型自身采集时，无论采用重用还是删除机制，模型在高跳过率（如0.9）下都会严重降级，而actuation-slack refresh法能完全恢复到近乎全token推理的性能（0.98），且在多套VLA策略与任务上修复全部崩溃现象。该方法还将延迟降低了18-22%。

Conclusion: 决定VLA加速模型可靠性的关键，是gate信号是否来自完整信息而非如何跳过token。actuation-slack refresh实现了速度与鲁棒性的兼得，对高效可靠VLA系统有广泛意义。

Abstract: Token skipping is a widely used training-free way to accelerate vision--language--action (VLA) models by bypassing computation for most visual tokens at each control step according to a gate. When the next gate is harvested from the previous accelerated forward, however, the tokens skipped at one step are also the ones least visible to the next gate, and the damage can compound across control steps until the task fails. We study the two mechanisms this class is built on, reuse and deletion, crossing each against where its gate signal comes from on identical episodes. At a skip ratio of 0.9 on LIBERO-Object, both collapse when the gate comes from the model's own accelerated forwards, to 0.68 under reuse and to 0.31 under deletion against a dense 1.00, and the collapse is invisible to the action-level detectors we evaluate. What separates collapse from dense-level operation is not the mechanism but whether the gate is clean, computed by a forward that skipped nothing. We therefore propose actuation-slack refresh, one dense pass run while the robot executes its current action chunk, off the critical path, that hands the next step a clean gate and a fresh KV base. Since the measured detectors do not reliably reveal the failure, the refresh is unconditional rather than triggered. Both mechanisms then recover to 0.98, keeping the speed of skipping and the information of a dense pass. We then integrate the refresh into state-of-the-art caching and pruning methods across two VLA policies, 4 LIBERO suites, and 4 SIMPLER tasks, where it repairs every collapse caused by using a self-harvested gate. Serve latency drops 18--22\% below dense, measured both in simulation and on a physical robot. Where the gate signal comes from, not how tokens are skipped, decides closed-loop reliability for accelerated VLAs.

</details>


### [420] [Embodied Passive Aeroacoustic Perception Enables Relative Sensing and Pursuit Between Aerial Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00401)
*Yanbaihui Liu,Ravi Prakash,Li-Yu Lo,Nils Roede,Boyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种利用飞行器自身产生的空气动力学声音进行机载相对感知的新方法，不依赖GPS或外部感知，仅通过被动感知飞行声音支持无人机编队和跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无人机相对感知主要依赖GPS、通信或主动声学信号，环境适应性和鲁棒性有限。作者关注无人机飞行时自然产生的空气动力学声音（而非主动发送信号）能否为机载感知提供有用信息，以提升系统独立性和部署灵活性。

Method: 提出SonicFly框架：被跟踪无人机仅用自身飞行动力声音，不用任何主动声学信号、通信或外部设备。跟随无人机搭载四麦克风、结合飞行器动力声建模、神经网络角度-距离估计器与置信门控滤波，实时推算目标位置信息并实现自主编队或跟踪。

Result: 通过声学信号分析、机载定位和户外跟踪实验，表明即使存在较强本体噪音和环境变化，所提出系统依然可有效提取相关信息，实现1.34米的平均跟踪误差，适应多种户外飞行线路。进一步声学分析揭示了设计原则，如和声结构、频谱可分性和空间声学线索等对可观测性的作用。

Conclusion: 自然生成的飞行行为类信号可作为空中机器人感知和协调的信息源，被动气动声感知是一种可行且有效的无人机编队与相对定位新途径，对提升无人系统的自治性和感知能力具有前景。

Abstract: Aerial robots generate structured aeroacoustic fields during flight, yet these signals have been underexplored as a source of onboard relative perception, particularly under the strong ego-acoustic interference generated during simultaneous flight in various outdoor conditions. We introduce embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, a sensing paradigm in which an aerial robot infers actionable relative-state information from the naturally generated sound of flight while operating within its own evolving aeroacoustic field. We present SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables one unmanned aerial vehicle to estimate and follow another using only the leader's intrinsic flight sound, without active acoustic signaling, inter-robot communication, GPS sharing, or external sensing infrastructure.
